# Third-party components

- GeckoView 158.0.20261007201254 — Mozilla, MPL-2.0 and bundled third-party notices. https://maven.mozilla.org/maven2/org/mozilla/geckoview/geckoview/158.0.20261007201254/ and https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
- Ruffle v0.7.1 — MIT OR Apache-2.0; exact URL/digest in ruffle.json. Source and licenses: https://github.com/ruffle-rs/ruffle/tree/v0.7.1 . Upstream license files are retained if included in the release archive; no game SWFs are redistributed.
  - App 0.1.27 rebuilds the page engine, coupled JS chunks and standard/MVP Wasm from pinned upstream source with `patches/ruffle-loader-image-cancel.patch`. It discards a cancelled image's delayed completion when the reused Loader holds another image. This is a project patch, not an upstream release. Source/patch hashes and tool version are in `ruffle-loader-fix.json`; corresponding source is downloaded and rebuilt by `tools/build_ruffle_engine.py`.
  - Extension package version `0.7.2.1` distinguishes the modified package for upgrades; its base is **0.7.1**, not upstream 0.7.2. ID, permissions and all non-runtime files remain upstream bytes. Embedded `time-casket-engine.json` lists provenance and runtime hashes. Both Wasm variants and JPEG XR remain enabled. No game SWF, inventory, PP value or game protocol is patched.
- Gradle wrapper 8.11.1 — Apache-2.0, https://github.com/gradle/gradle/tree/v8.11.1 . Wrapper/distribution hashes checked by Gradle setup action and wrapper properties.
- AndroidX — Apache-2.0, https://source.android.com/docs/setup/about/licenses . Kotlin — Apache-2.0, https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin .
- Java-WebSocket 1.6.0 — MIT, https://github.com/TooTallNate/Java-WebSocket/tree/v1.6.0 ; used for the restricted app-local WebSocket transport. Transitive SLF4J API 2.0.13 — MIT, https://www.slf4j.org/license.html . Neither library implements game authentication or game protocol logic.

App fixture SWF is original test data generated by LocalProbeServer; it is not extracted from Tencent content. The application is unofficial and does not own the game's trademarks, accounts, website or resources.
